raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #45032

## Summary

InternVL cannot load checkpoints that use a GPT-OSS language model. Its weight loader handles several language-model architectures directly, but GPT-OSS requires its own loader to process the backbone weights. Without that delegation, loading fails with an `UnboundLocalError` before the model can start.

This affects checkpoints such as `OpenGVLab/InternVL3_5-GPT-OSS-20B-A4B-Preview`.

## Changes

- Route `language_model.*` tensors through `GptOssForCausalLM.load_weights`, stripping the `language_model.` prefix expected by that loader.
- Keep vision-model and projector tensors in InternVL's existing wrapper-level loading path.
- Preserve ownership of tensors retained after streaming, matching the GPT-OSS mxfp4 loading path.
- Add a CPU unit test covering backbone delegation and vision/projector weight loading.

Delegating to the GPT-OSS loader also lets it handle its format-specific weight transformations and expert layouts.

## Validation

- CPU unit test: passed. On the base revision, the test reproduces the `UnboundLocalError`; with this change, it passes.
- Formatting and lint checks listed below: clean.
- No GPU end-to-end run has been performed. This change unblocks weight loading; successful serving of InternVL3.5-GPT-OSS has not been verified.

## Accuracy Tests

Not run. The model could not load before this change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).

- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch

-from sglang.srt.models.gpt_oss import GptOssForCausalLM
+from sglang.srt.models.gpt_oss import GptOssForCausalLM, _own_if_runai_streamed
 from sglang.srt.models.internlm2 import InternLM2ForCausalLM
 from sglang.srt.models.qwen2 import Qwen2ForCausalLM
 from sglang.srt.models.qwen3 import Qwen3ForCausalLM
@@ -727,6 +727,21 @@ def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]):
                 ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
                 ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
             ]
+        elif self.config.llm_config.architectures[0] == "GptOssForCausalLM":
+            # GPT-OSS has its own loader; this loop handles the wrapper weights.
+            stacked_params_mapping = []
+            other_weights = []
+            language_weights = []
+            for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+                if name.startswith("language_model."):
+                    language_weights.append(
+                        (name[len("language_model.") :], loaded_weight)
+                    )
+                else:
+                    other_weights.append((name, _own_if_runai_streamed(loaded_weight)))
+
+            self.language_model.load_weights(iter(language_weights))
+            weights = other_weights
 
         params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters())

@@ -34,6 +36,7 @@ def forward(self, x):
 
 from sglang import Engine
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest

 from sglang.srt.parser.conversation import generate_chat_conv

@@ -455,6 +458,35 @@ def _processor_output_image_data(self, processor_output):
 #         return dict(processor_output, format="processor_output")
 
 
+class TestInternVLGptOssWeightLoading(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_gpt_oss_backbone_weights_go_to_its_own_loader(self):
+        model = InternVLChatModel.__new__(InternVLChatModel)
+        torch.nn.Module.__init__(model)
+        model.config = SimpleNamespace(
+            llm_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=["GptOssForCausalLM"]),
+            vision_config=SimpleNamespace(num_dummy_heads=0),
+        )
+        model.language_model = Mock()
+        model.vision_model = torch.nn.Module()
+        model.vision_model.norm = torch.nn.LayerNorm(2)
+        model.mlp1 = torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.LayerNorm(2), torch.nn.Linear(2, 2))
+        weights = [
+            ("language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight", torch.zeros(1)),
+            ("vision_model.norm.weight", torch.full((2,), 2.0)),
+            ("mlp1.1.bias", torch.full((2,), 3.0)),
+        ]
+
+        model.load_weights(iter(weights))
+
+        model.language_model.load_weights.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            list(model.language_model.load_weights.call_args.args[0]),
+            [("model.embed_tokens.weight", weights[0][1])],
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(model.vision_model.norm.weight, weights[1][1])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(model.mlp1[1].bias, weights[2][1])
+
